{{Top|leg}}
'''''Nemzet''''' was a [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] used by a [[AZ 77 (Venzeiia 2)|salvage yard]] that was hiding criminals, including a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] arrived to disable the criminals' [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transports]]. The Patrol Craft was in need of repair so the platform sent a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] called ''[[Poltroon]]'' to repair the craft along with [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Renspecs]]''. Whether the shuttle did repair the patrol craft was unclear but either way the patrol craft was destroyed by the Imperials.
